abaplint-abapdoc-block-placement.describe: an ABAP Doc block whose next statement is a chain keyword or a section end, with the correct in-chain placement as the negative

abaplint-delete-index-in-loop.describe: DELETE <t> INDEX sy-tabix inside an open LOOP AT <t>, and the correct READ-TABLE-then-DELETE form as the negative

abaplint-subrc-after-assign.describe: a sy-subrc test whose nearest sy-subrc-setting statement is a plain ASSIGN, with ASSIGN COMPONENT as the negative

transpiler-reserved-js-identifiers.describe: an ABAP declaration named after a reserved JavaScript word, with the seven abap2UI5 already configures as the negatives

abaplint-downport-builtin-operand.describe: a 7.02 built-in function in a table-expression key, a WITH KEY operand or an internal-table WHERE, with the functional method call in the same positions as the negative
